product_metadata.title: 36 Pieces Thanksgiving Wine Bottle Labels Stickers Thanksgiving Party Wine Bottle Decorations Self-Adhesive Wine Bottle Stickers for Thanksgiving Party Wine Champagne Decor Supplies
features: Large quantity: you will receive 36 pieces of Thanksgiving wine bottle stickers in 6 different pattern styles, and each style accounts for 6 pieces, enough quantity for you to decorate bottles when holding a party or take them as backups to replace dirty or broken ones

Thanksgiving theme: there are various thanksgiving patterns printed on these Thanksgiving wine bottle labels, such as pumpkins, leaves, berries and so on; And you can decorate your wine bottles with these champagne stickers on Thanksgiving Day, adding a festival atmosphere to your Thanksgiving party

Easy to use: each Thanksgiving wine bottle sticker is separate with its own back glue; When using, you only need to tear off the sticker along the line of the edge, and then you can paste it directly on the wine bottle; When pasting, it is recommended to paste it from an edge or corner first and press it down slowly to get a better effect

Multiple uses: Thanksgiving wine bottle covers can not only be applied to decorations of wine bottles, but also be taken as large decorative stickers on your present boxes, present bags; You can also cut them to the desired sizes and stick them on cards

Make the wine bottle distinctive: the Thanksgiving wine bottle label stickers can make your wine bottles more festive and different, showing your initiative table preparation and making your guests feel valued; Made of paper material, the stickers are light in weight and reliable to use
description: Features:  Proper size: The size of each bottle sticker is approx. 5 x 4 inches, which is suitable for most wine and champagne bottles. If the size of the sticker is larger than the original bottle label, you can directly cover it and decorate your Thanksgiving wine bottle.  Gift supplies: The large quantity of Thanksgiving wine bottle stickers allows you to share them with your friends, colleagues, neighbors, so you can send these wine bottle labels as practical gifts to them.
